```{r include=FALSE}
library("RDAVIDWebService")
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
sign_DEGS = data.frame(readxl::read_excel("DEGresults_Mreg_UKR_vs_Mreg_Kiel_SIGN_withGOann.xlsx", skip = 1))
all_DEGS = data.frame(readxl::read_excel("DEGresults_Mreg_UKR_vs_Mreg_Kiel_FULL.xlsx", skip = 1))
```

```{r}

#if problems, see e.g. 
#https://stackoverflow.com/questions/31480579/r-david-webservice-sudden-transport-error-301-error-moved-permanently
david<-DAVIDWebService$new(email="meeri.pekkarinen@geneviatechnologies.com", url="https://david.ncifcrf.gov/webservice/services/DAVIDWebService.DAVIDWebServiceHttpSoap12Endpoint/")

```
```{r}
# Defining foreground and background gene lists.
# The foreground list should be contained within the background list.

# > getIdTypes(david)

# [17] "GENBANK_ACCESSION"        "GENOMIC_GI_ACCESSION"     "GENPEPT_ACCESSION"        "LOCUS_TAG"               
# [21] "MGI_ID"                   "MIRBASE_ID"               "MRNA_GI_ACCESSION"        "NASONIABASE_ID"          
# [25] "PROTEIN_GI_ACCESSION"     "PSEUDOCAP_ID"             "REFSEQ_MRNA"              "REFSEQ_PROTEIN"          
# [29] "RGD_ID"                   "SGD_ID"                   "TAIR_ID"                  "UNIGENE"                 
# [33] "UNIPROT_ACCESSION"        "UNIPROT_ID"               "VECTORBASE_ID"            "WORMBASE_GENE_ID"        
# [37] "

#getTimeOut(david)
#[1] 30000        #Proved too small for at least the list of over 20 000 BG-genes

setTimeOut(david, 60000)

# Defining foreground and background gene lists.
# The foreground list should be contained within the background list.
FG <- addList(david, sign_DEGS$Ensembl.ID, idType="ENSEMBL_GENE_ID", listName="isClass", listType="Gene")
BG <- addList(david, all_DEGS$Ensembl.ID, idType="ENSEMBL_GENE_ID", listName="all", listType="Background")

#> FG$inDavid
#[1] 0.8197142

#> BG$inDavid
#[1] 0.7692232

```
```{r}
setAnnotationCategories(david, c("GOTERM_BP_FAT", "KEGG_PATHWAY")) #one or more Term types can be given.
#GOTERM_BP_FAT is more specific option than GOTERM_BP_ALL!

FuncAnnotChart <- getFunctionalAnnotationChart(david, threshold=0.05, count=3L) #PValue < 0.05, at least 3 genes
colnames(FuncAnnotChart)
termCluster<-getClusterReport(david, type="Term")
```
```{r}
dim(FuncAnnotChart)
#head(FuncAnnotChart[order(FuncAnnotChart$Benjamini), c("Term", "PValue", "Benjamini" )], 20)
filtered_FuncAnnotChart = FuncAnnotChart[FuncAnnotChart$Benjamini < 0.05,]
dim(filtered_FuncAnnotChart)

filtered_FuncAnnotChart = filtered_FuncAnnotChart[order(filtered_FuncAnnotChart$Benjamini),]

#Saving GO-terms only:
write.table(filtered_FuncAnnotChart[filtered_FuncAnnotChart$Category == "GOTERM_BP_FAT",], 
            file="GOBP_DAVID_Mreg_UKR_vs_Mreg_Kiel_filtered.xls", row.names = FALSE,
         col.names = TRUE)
```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
head(summary(termCluster), 20)
#max(summary(termCluster)$Enrichment)
#[1] 4.751006
#min(summary(termCluster)$Enrichment)
#[1] 9.891927e-12

for( i in 1:dim(summary(termCluster))[1]){
  if(summary(termCluster)$Members[i] > 10 && summary(termCluster)$Members[i] < 20 && summary(termCluster)$Enrichment[i] > 1.5){
    clustNumber<-i
    print(plot2D(termCluster, clustNumber))
  }
}
```

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
for( i in 1:dim(summary(termCluster))[1]){
  if(summary(termCluster)$Members[i] > 10 && summary(termCluster)$Members[i] < 20 && summary(termCluster)$Enrichment[i] > 1.5){
    clustNumber<-i
     davidGODag<-DAVIDGODag(members(termCluster)[[clustNumber]], pvalueCutoff=0.05, "BP")
     print(plotGOTermGraph(g=goDag(davidGODag), r=davidGODag, max.nchar=40, node.shape="ellipse"))
     dev.off()
  }
}
```
